scope: Original Freeze fixture has two audible clouds, changes requested capture length from1s to.25s and attempts capture from silence; the energy gate fails after copying into the candidate.
implications: A failed capture still mutates the fading candidate cloud audio.
When length shrinks, the old readable suffix survives a failed capture.
A single new snapshot window per cloud cannot represent that prefix-plus-older-suffix state.
An exact snapshot implementation needs a bounded piecewise history representation or another proven design.
The quarter-energy eligibility check also needs separate exactness/performance treatment; storage metadata alone does not make capture O(1).
next: Keep the allocator-free v1 core experimental/worker-backed. No naive copy-on-write replacement is integrated.
